definition: One Work iteration = one bounded author/reconstruction, independent QA, fix or retest task, not one row or calendar day.
calculation: 31 nonreplacement units ×1 +12 replacement units ×2 =55 author passes; up to10 additional pre-QA architecture attempts.43 QA units minus8 optional pairings =35 minimum.8–15 post-QA fix cycles ×(fix+retest)=16–30. Final1–2globalQA+1cleanup+1explicit freeze=3–4.
assumptions: Planning scenario, not observed success probability. A failed frozen-level feasibility or rejected coverage decision can exceed this range or block freeze. Architecture retries here exclude post-QA fix cycles to avoid double count.
bundleRules: Only after both author units finish and combined cross-duplication/regression passes; do not hold a high-risk unresolved family merely to fill a bundle. Separate verdicts. Never import/freeze from self-QA.
